description: This Java class defines an immutable implementation of the PayloadMappingDefinition interface, providing methods to create, manipulate, serialize, and compare payload mapping definitions within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ImmutablePayloadMappingDefinition
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the PayloadMappingDefinition interface, managing a map of string identifiers to MappingContext instances, with methods for JSON serialization, equality, and building.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a PayloadMappingDefinition from the provided map of definitions.

methods.name: getDefinitions
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable view of the definitions map.

methods.name: withDefinition
methods.description: Returns a new PayloadMappingDefinition with an added or updated definition for the given id.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the definitions map is empty.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a PayloadMappingDefinition from a JSON object.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the definition to a JSON object, given a schema version and predicate.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code based on definitions.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the object.
